detailed_descriptions.en: THE ETERNAL PALACE Step into the dreamscape of the Eternal Palace. You are Retla, a cat-eared dual-weapon-wielder, tasked with navigating an ever changing labyrinth that challenges every adventurer who dares enter. Each run is a test of skill, cunning, and courage. THE DREAM LABYRINTH Every corridor changes with each attempt, revealing new dangers, hidden treasures, and unexpected secrets. No two runs are the same: explore, adapt, and master the ever-changing maze. MASTER THE COMBAT Your arsenal consists in dual blades, flashy combos, and fast-paced dodges. Strike, evade, and chain attacks in a style all your own. Every enemy is a puzzle and every battle a chance to prove your skill. ROGUELITE PROGRESSION With every attempt, grow stronger. Unlock new abilities, weapons, and upgrades that carry over into future runs. Adapt your skills, experiment with strategies, and continue your endless journey through the ever-changing labyrinth. FEATURES Thrilling 3D action with responsive dual-wield combat. Procedurally generated labyrinths full of traps, treasures, and mysteries. High replayability with evolving challenges. Anime-inspired fantasy world with a memorable, heroic protagonist. ENTER THE LABYRINTH Face various cunning enemies, unravel shifting paths, and rise stronger with each run. The Eternal Palace awaits: will you master its trials, or be lost to its mysteries forever? MUGEN DEPTH: THE DEEPER YOU GO, THE GREATER THE DANGER As you venture deeper into the labyrinth, your Mugen Depth rises, bringing debuffs and ever-stronger enemies. Weighing risk against reward keeps every run tense and makes you want to dive in again and again. STORY Retla Stlutin, a cat-eared heroine, has heard rumors of a mysterious tower that rises endlessly into the heavens, and has come all the way to Ouran, a land in the Far East. After overcoming countless hardships, Retla finally reaches the tower. But the moment she steps inside, she becomes trapped within its walls... Retla battles through hordes of enemies, collecting spoils and rare treasures as she goes. Just how far can she make it into the Eternal Palace Sakura! Brave the ever-shifting eternal labyrinth and conquer the mighty bosses and endgame challenges lurking in its deepest floors!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
THE ETERNAL PALACE

Step into the dreamscape of the Eternal Palace. You are Retla, a cat-eared dual-weapon-wielder, tasked with navigating an ever changing labyrinth that challenges every adventurer who dares enter. Each run is a test of skill, cunning, and courage.

THE DREAM LABYRINTH

Every corridor changes with each attempt, revealing new dangers, hidden treasures, and unexpected secrets. No two runs are the same: explore, adapt, and master the ever-changing maze.

MASTER THE COMBAT

Your arsenal consists in dual blades, flashy combos, and fast-paced dodges. Strike, evade, and chain attacks in a style all your own. Every enemy is a puzzle and every battle a chance to prove your skill.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

With every attempt, grow stronger. Unlock new abilities, weapons, and upgrades that carry over into future runs. Adapt your skills, experiment with strategies, and continue your endless journey through the ever-changing labyrinth.

FEATURES

Thrilling 3D action with responsive dual-wield combat.

Procedurally generated labyrinths full of traps, treasures, and mysteries.

High replayability with evolving challenges.

Anime-inspired fantasy world with a memorable, heroic protagonist.

ENTER THE LABYRINTH

Face various cunning enemies, unravel shifting paths, and rise stronger with each run. The Eternal Palace awaits: will you master its trials, or be lost to its mysteries forever?

MUGEN DEPTH: THE DEEPER YOU GO, THE GREATER THE DANGER

As you venture deeper into the labyrinth, your Mugen Depth rises, bringing debuffs and ever-stronger enemies.

Weighing risk against reward keeps every run tense and makes you want to dive in again and again.

STORY

Retla Stlutin, a cat-eared heroine, has heard rumors of a mysterious tower that rises endlessly into the heavens, and has come all the way to Ouran, a land in the Far East.
After overcoming countless hardships, Retla finally reaches the tower. But the moment she steps inside, she becomes trapped within its walls...
Retla battles through hordes of enemies, collecting spoils and rare treasures as she goes. Just how far can she make it into the Eternal Palace Sakura!

Brave the ever-shifting eternal labyrinth and conquer the mighty bosses and endgame challenges lurking in its deepest floors!
